instruction: Studio photograph, full shot. In an indoor studio with draped beige curtains, a shirtless man in black pants (R2) stands facing forward, looking down at a woman in a beige sports bra and black shorts (R1). The woman is suspended in a side-lying pose, her left leg extended and right leg bent. The shirtless man supports her by holding her left thigh and her raised hand. No bystanders are present. Soft, warm studio lighting illuminates the scene, casting gentle shadows on the fabric background.
